sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Red Enamel Tulip Gold Pendant Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a romantic statement with this striking red enamel tulip necklace. The vibrant crimson bud and lustrous green leaves are set against a premium gold-toned chain, offering a bold yet classic floral aesthetic. This durable, anti-tarnish piece is an ideal gift for special occasions or everyday elegance.
